page.layout: One printed page, a title page, all text centred and printed upside down on the scan. Top: a small line of type, then large spaced capitals, then three lines in italic, then a large capitalised line, then three small lines at the foot of the block. No running head, page number or notes in the margins.
page.notes: The scan is printed upside down, so the lines were read after rotating the image by 180 degrees. The first line, the italic lines and the three small lines at the foot are too faint or too small to read reliably, so they are marked illegible. The third and fourth lines are the least certain readings: the fourth in particular may read differently from what is given. No engraving, stamp or marginal text is visible.
